verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party MCP server lets AI assistants work with accounts, transactions, recipients and cards. The docs say users can query balances, transaction history and account data in natural language, with examples like "What's my balance today?" and "Graph my last 6 months of transactions". An official skills directory also drives the Mercury CLI from agents. Missing for 10: documented natural-language examples for write operations such as payments or invoices, any in-product natural-language interface beyond external AI clients, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Query balances, transaction history, and account data in natural language
you can ask natural language questions like `What's my balance today?` and `Graph my last 6 months of transactions`. The Mercury MCP will accurately and quickly return your Mercury data.
